Leistung (W, Stundenwerte) und Verbrauch im laufenden Kalenderjahr (seit 1. Januar), unabhängig vom gewählten Zeitraum. Der Durchschnitt ergibt sich aus dem gemessenen Verbrauch über die Zeitspanne.

targets.query:
import "date"
import "dict"
import "timezone"

option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Berlin")

cutoff = date.truncate(t: date.sub(d: 85d, from: now()), unit: 1d)
jahresbeginn = date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1y)
names = ["tasmota_energy_power": "Kühlschrank", "tasmota_energy_total": "Kühlschrank", "tasmota_energy_power_2": "Server", "tasmota_energy_total_2": "Server", "tasmota_energy_power_3": "Workstation", "tasmota_energy_total_3": "Workstation", "tasmota_energy_power_4": "Waschmaschine", "tasmota_energy_total_4": "Waschmaschine"]
preis = float(v: "${Strompreis}") / 100.0

// Raw data after the cutoff, 30m means before it. Each bucket is aggregated
// directly after the filter so InfluxDB can do it in the storage engine
// (push-down); that only works with UTC windows, hence the explicit location.
// The cutoff is applied to the few aggregated rows afterwards.
load = (measurement, re, start, stop, every, fn) => {
    raw = from(bucket: "sensor_data")
        |> range(start: start, stop: stop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == measurement and r._field == "value" and r.entity_id =~ re)
        |> aggregateWindow(every: every, fn: fn, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start", location: timezone.utc)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time > cutoff)
    downsampled = from(bucket: "sensor_data_30m")
        |> range(start: start, stop: stop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == measurement and r._field == "value" and r.entity_id =~ re)
        |> aggregateWindow(every: every, fn: fn, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start", location: timezone.utc)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time <= cutoff)

    return union(tables: [raw, downsampled])
        |> group(columns: ["entity_id"])
        |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
        |> toFloat()
}

// Per-row map() is expensive in Flux, so device names are only attached to
// the few aggregated result rows.
deviceName = (r) => dict.get(dict: names, key: r.entity_id, default: r.entity_id)

// kWh per hour from the Tasmota counter (hourly max of the monotonic counter);
// counter resets (negative steps) and implausible jumps (e.g. counter briefly
// reported as 0) are dropped.
consumption = (re, start, stop) => load(measurement: "kWh", re: re, start: start, stop: stop, every: 1h, fn: max)
    |> difference(nonNegative: true)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value and r._value < 5.0)

power = (fn) => load(measurement: "W", re: /^tasmota_energy_power(_[234])?$/, start: jahresbeginn, stop: now(), every: 1h, fn: fn)
counter = load(measurement: "kWh", re: /^tasmota_energy_total(_[234])?$/, start: jahresbeginn, stop: now(), every: 1h, fn: max)

union(tables: [
    power(fn: min) |> min() |> map(fn: (r) => ({device: deviceName(r: r), _field: "Minimum", _value: r._value})),
    power(fn: max) |> max() |> map(fn: (r) => ({device: deviceName(r: r), _field: "Maximum", _value: r._value})),
    consumption(re: /^tasmota_energy_total(_[234])?$/, start: jahresbeginn, stop: now()) |> sum() |> map(fn: (r) => ({device: deviceName(r: r), _field: "Verbrauch", _value: r._value})),
    counter |> elapsed(unit: 1s) |> sum(column: "elapsed") |> map(fn: (r) => ({device: deviceName(r: r), _field: "Sekunden", _value: float(v: r.elapsed)})),
])
    |> group()
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["device"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    // Average power derived from the metered energy over the covered time span.
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        "Gerät": r.device,
        "Minimum": r.Minimum,
        "Maximum": r.Maximum,
        "Durchschnitt": if r.Sekunden > 0.0 then r.Verbrauch * 1000.0 / (r.Sekunden / 3600.0) else 0.0,
        "Verbrauch": r.Verbrauch,
        "Kosten": r.Verbrauch * preis,
    }))
    |> sort(columns: ["Gerät"])

        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time > cutoff)
    downsampled = from(bucket: "sensor_data_30m")
        |> range(start: start, stop: stop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == measurement and r._field == "value" and r.entity_id =~ re)
        |> aggregateWindow(every: every, fn: fn, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start", location: timezone.utc)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time <= cutoff)

    return union(tables: [raw, downsampled])
        |> group(columns: ["entity_id"])
        |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
        |> toFloat()
}

// Per-row map() is expensive in Flux, so device names are only attached to
// the few aggregated result rows.
deviceName = (r) => dict.get(dict: names, key: r.entity_id, default: r.entity_id)

// kWh per hour from the Tasmota counter (hourly max of the monotonic counter);
// counter resets (negative steps) and implausible jumps (e.g. counter briefly

consumption = (re, start, stop) => load(measurement: "kWh", re: re, start: start, stop: stop, every: 1h, fn: max)
    |> difference(nonNegative: true)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value and r._value < 5.0)

consumption(re: /^tasmota_energy_total(_[234])?$/, start: 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z, stop: now())
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 1y, fn: sum, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({"Jahr": string(v: date.year(t: r._time)), device: deviceName(r: r), _value: r._value}))
    |> group()
    |> sort(columns: ["device"])
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["Jahr"], columnKey: ["device"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> sort(columns: ["Jahr"])
